entities.name: David Refael ben Ami
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: David Refael ben-Ami was an Israeli singer. In 1970, he recorded the song "Desdemona," which was composed for him by Mati Caspi and written by Gad Kaynar. In 1971, Desdemona reached the top of the Israeli Hit Parade.
